verdict.rationale: Statsig documents an official CLI that can be integrated into CI/CD pipelines to automate Feature Gate and Experiment management, plus a Console API for CRUD actions without the web UI, so headless, scripted automation is a first-party capability. A probe independently confirms the CLI docs exist. Missing for 10: in-depth CI setup documentation (non-interactive auth, example pipeline configs), independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: You can integrate the CLI into CI/CD pipelines to automate the management of Feature Gates and Experiments.
The Statsig CLI is a command-line interface that helps manage Feature Gates, Experiments, and Dynamic Configs within the Statsig platform.
The Console API is the CRUD API for performing the actions available on console.statsig.com without using the web UI.
